integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically by continuant sum-step domination and a Fibonacci product inequality. A standalone finite verifier exhausts positive compositions only as a sanity check and is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: The monic-character count requires the curve-component hypotheses of Kim--Morifuji. Sharpness is proved for the determinant bound, not for the resulting character-count estimate; the result is restricted to two-bridge knots.
title: Sharp Fibonacci crossing bounds for monic characters of two-bridge knots
